description: This PHP test class 'PurgeStrategyTest' is part of the OrangeHRM system. It tests the functionality of the 'PurgeStrategy' class, focusing on methods related to entity record retrieval, parameter access, and service provision within the context of the Maintenace plugin's purge strategy. The test covers interaction with the 'Employee' entity and includes setup for fixture data.

classes.name: PurgeStrategyTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the PurgeStrategy functionality within the OrangeHRM maintenance plugin, focusing on entity record retrieval, parameter handling, and service access.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, mocks PurgeStrategy, and loads fixture data.

methods.name: testGetPurgeEmployeeService
methods.description: Verifies that getPurgeService returns an instance of PurgeService.

methods.name: testGetMatchByValues
methods.description: Tests getMatchByValues returns expected matching criteria array.

methods.name: testGetPurgeRecords
methods.description: Checks that getEntityRecords retrieves the correct Employee entity record based on match criteria.

methods.name: testGetParameters
methods.description: Validates getParameters returns the expected parameters array.

methods.name: testGetEntityFieldMap
methods.description: Checks that getEntityFieldMap returns the correct mapping of match and join fields.
